style: bold cel-shaded toon, thick dark outlines, flat neon rim light, high-contrast vertical arcade
notes: One art style for the whole project, repeated word for word at the head of every prompt (rule F.1c). Every mechanical sprite declares its orientation in words (rule C.8); the symmetric ones say so explicitly so nothing is mirrored by accident - only sprite_arrow_dial and sprite_icon_back are asymmetric. Sprites are drawn on whatever backdrop the model likes because the pipeline cuts the background away (rule F.1b), so no prompt argues about background colour. sprite_ledge_plate, sprite_anchor_ring, sprite_shutter_panel, sprite_shaft_back, sprite_shaft_ring and sprite_shaft_wall carry a nine-slice border in their .meta, so their prompts ask for uniform end caps and a plain centre that survives stretching. There is no audio in this game, so the manifest declares none. No prompt contains the app name and no sprite carries lettering of any kind (hard rule 1).
